categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; practice and provision of veterinary teletriage and veterinary telemedicine; revise provisions
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends Georgia law to revise provisions regarding veterinary teletriage and telemedicine services, explicitly including veterinary technicians in the scope of who can provide these services. The legislation directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals can practice and deliver remote veterinary care within the state.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the scope of practice for veterinary technicians and technologists by specifying which services they may perform under veterinarian supervision and which services are restricted to licensed veterinarians only. It also establishes that veterinarians bear responsibility for all services performed by their licensed paraprofessional staff and revises the Board of Veterinary Medicine's membership.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes registration requirements for Veterinary Professional Associates (VPA), including obtaining certificates of registration from the Department of Business and Professional Regulation, public listing of registrants, and grounds for registration rescission. It also expands telehealth prescription authority for certain drugs.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates a new veterinary paraprofessional role called 'veterinary professional associate' (VPA) by defining the credential, establishing a state registration process through DBPR, and outlining scope of practice limitations and regulatory oversight by the Board of Veterinary Medicine. It also expands telehealth prescription authority for certain drugs.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes licensure requirements, scope of practice, and regulatory oversight for veterinary technicians in the state. It defines what licensed veterinary technicians can do, what tasks veterinarians can delegate to them, and creates disciplinary mechanisms while also addressing unlicensed veterinary assistants and title protection.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands access to veterinary services by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enables telehealth establishment of veterinarian-client-patient relationships for urgent conditions. These changes affect the scope of work and supervision requirements for veterinary paraprofessionals who work under veterinarian oversight.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill regulates how veterinary care providers can use medical credit cards and handle payment for services and products. It restricts aggressive marketing of credit cards and requires transparency about financing options, which affects paraprofessionals who may interact with clients about payment arrangements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill continues licensing requirements for pet animal care facilities under the Pet Animal Care and Facilities Act. It is relevant to veterinary paraprofessionals as it establishes regulatory standards and oversight for facilities where they commonly work, including boarding facilities, shelters, and breeding operations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care through multiple mechanisms including expedited licensure by endorsement for veterinarians, clarification of prescription and compounded drug use, and a drug donation program. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensing and drug access, these provisions directly impact the scope of practice and working conditions for veterinary paraprofessionals who work under veterinary supervision and handle prescribed medications.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary practice laws to regulate cat declawing procedures, which are surgical interventions performed by licensed veterinarians. The legislation directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals by defining what procedures veterinarians can perform and potentially restricting surgical delegation to veterinary team members.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is directly relevant to veterinary paraprofessionals who administer medications, assist in prescribing decisions, and handle antibiotics in clinical practice. Veterinary paraprofessionals play a key role in implementing antimicrobial stewardship protocols and educating pet owners about appropriate antibiotic use.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Senate amendments concurred in. To Engrossing and Enrolling. (Ayes 77. Noes 0.).
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends multiple sections of California's veterinary medicine regulations in the Business and Professions Code, including provisions related to licensure, scope of practice, and professional standards. The addition of new sections and repeal of others suggests significant changes to how veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals are regulated and supervised.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends the Business and Professions Code to modify the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants in California. It directly addresses what tasks and procedures these paraprofessionals are legally authorized to perform in veterinary medicine.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine law to modify requirements for the veterinarian-client-patient relationship, which is fundamental to defining what tasks veterinary paraprofessionals can perform under veterinary supervision. Changes to this relationship directly impact the scope of practice and delegation authority for all veterinary support staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends veterinary medicine regulations under the California Veterinary Medical Board, modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code that govern veterinary practice. The amendments likely affect credentialing, scope of practice, supervision requirements, and regulatory oversight of veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This appropriation bill allocates funding to the Department of Education's Division of Higher Education for fiscal year 2026-2027, which may support educational programs and institutions that train veterinary paraprofessionals. The funding could directly impact the availability and quality of veterinary technician, technologist, nurse, and assistant training programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight rules for veterinary practices, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals can be employed and supervised. Ownership and oversight regulations typically establish requirements for practice structure, management, and the employment relationships between veterinarians and their support staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses animal abuse and neglect classification, which directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who are often first-line responders in identifying and reporting suspected abuse or neglect cases. Veterinary team members play a critical role in documenting evidence, assisting with examinations of affected animals, and supporting legal proceedings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician education pathways and certification requirements, creating alternative routes for individuals to become certified veterinary technicians and obtain professional credentials.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses certification and education pathways for veterinary technicians, establishing alternative routes to meet certification requirements. It directly impacts how veterinary technicians can qualify and become credentialed in their profession.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which directly impacts veterinary practices and the paraprofessional workforce that performs these common surgical procedures. Veterinary technicians, assistants, and other paraprofessionals would be involved in executing spay and neuter surgeries under veterinarian supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses for certain professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals seeking to work while awaiting full licensure or certification. Temporary permits may allow veterinary technicians, nurses, and other paraprofessionals to practice under provisional credentials during transitions or workforce shortages.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals in the state. The extension ensures continued oversight and regulation of veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other veterinary paraprofessionals through the board's licensing and examination functions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates temporary licensing permits for certain professions, which could allow veterinary paraprofessionals to work provisionally while completing full licensure requirements or during licensing transitions. Temporary permits may expedite workforce entry and address staffing shortages in veterinary practices.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals in Alaska, directly involving veterinarians and veterinary technicians in emergency response protocols. It requires coordination through the State Emergency Response Commission and local emergency planning committees to ensure veterinary professionals are prepared for disaster situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines and modifies veterinary practice laws, including the powers and duties of veterinarians and their liability. It potentially impacts scope of practice and delegation authority for veterinary paraprofessionals in emergency medical situations involving working dogs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Dogs; tethering and confinement requirements provided; persons and activities exempted; criminal penalties for, animal control officer enforcement of, violations established
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes tethering and confinement requirements for dogs with criminal penalties for violations and animal control officer enforcement authority. Veterinary paraprofessionals may encounter animals subject to these regulations during clinical practice and may be involved in documenting animal welfare concerns or injuries related to improper confinement for legal proceedings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes tuition grants and loan forgiveness programs for allied health professionals training in rural areas through the Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund. The legislation directly supports recruitment and retention of veterinary paraprofessionals by providing financial incentives for education and rural practice.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill defines and clarifies the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which directly impacts what tasks veterinary paraprofessionals are authorized to perform under veterinarian supervision and delegation.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
